violation_type.title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605 (26 TAC §745.621(a)(7))
violation_type.short_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation failed to submit a background check to CBCU for a caregiver present with children at the time of inspection.

finding_variants.text: The operation failed to submit a background check to CBCU for a caregiver present with children at the time of inspection.
A household member present in the home during the inspection did not have a background check on file.

Based on information obtained during the investigation there is sufficient information to prove a 15 year old was present at the operation without a background check. The 15 year old is counted in ratio for the children.
The primary caregivers adult son has been present at the home during daycare hours of operation without a background check.
The homeowners son was present at the home without an active background check.
A 15 year old was observed at the operation without an active background check.
